name: MP-20
protocol: Up to 20 atoms per cell; use the released split, preprocessing and matcher. Canonical split sizes are 27,136 / 9,047 / 9,046.

name: MPTS-52
protocol: Up to 52 atoms per cell, not 52 test structures. Sometimes mistyped MPST-52. Preserve the chronological split.

name: CSPBench
protocol: 180-target study; the DFT-based baseline comparison uses a separate 23-target subset.

name: T180
protocol: 180 targets in v3.1. Integer atom counts of the geometric primitive cell are supplied. Use the reference and query manifests; do not assume identity with the historical CSPBench cohort.

name: T46
protocol: 46 targets in v3.1. Keep its own denominator and primitive-cell-count query manifest.

name: CSPMetrics / CSPBenchMetrics
protocol: Complementary geometry, graph, fingerprint, diffraction and energy comparisons. This is a toolkit, not a single fixed benchmark cohort.
